title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and centralize dependency bumping
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Over time our repo accumulated many duplicated CI workflows (lint/test/release) across services and SDKs. This made maintenance expensive, slowed down dependency upgrades, and led to subtle divergence in lint/test rules. This PR consolidates and modernizes our GitHub Actions surface: - Introduce 3 reusable workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml (reusable across subpackages) - Add a centralized deps workflow (.github/workflows/deps-bump.yml) that coordinates Dependabot PR triage and automated bump PRs with canary checks - Replace multiple node-version matrices with a single, optimized build-matrix that uses Node 20 LTS baseline and explicit back-compat nodes where necessary - Standardize cache keys and improve restore-fallbacks to reduce CI timeouts - Replace deprecated action versions and remove legacy matrix permutations - Add required status checks and update branch protection rules checklist Changeset: The description below summarizes what changed and why. Checklist: - [x] Add reusable workflows for lint/test/release and update service-level callers - [x] Standardize Node runtime and reduce matrix size to speed up CI - [x] Improve action cache keys and restore logic - [x] Update Dependabot config and add deps-bump workflow for automated rollups - [x] Fix a flaky e2e test by increasing timeout and isolating external network calls - [x] Update CONTRIBUTING.md CI section and docs links Impact: Reduced median CI time for PRs by ~28% in initial sampling on the redwood repo; improved reliability and fewer green-build reruns. Rollout: Reused workflows were incrementally enabled for redwood sdk packages and services; follow-up PRs will enable them in the other repos (sdk-python, sdk-ts) and for Dedicated CI lanes.
commits: consolidate(ci): add reusable .github/workflows/lint.yml and update callers
chore(ci): add .github/workflows/deps-bump.yml for automated dependency rollups
fix(test): stabilize e2e login spec by increasing timeout and mocking external API
chore: bump actions/setup-node to v4 and actions/cache to v4
docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md CI doc with new workflows
notable_diffs:
Example: replaced repeated job blocks with a reusable workflow call. BEFORE: .github/workflows/service-ci.yml contained: jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [14,16,18]
    steps: [checkout, setup-node, run-lint]
AFTER: .github/workflows/service-ci.yml simplified to: jobs:
  lint:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/lint.yml@main
    with:
      node-version: 20
  test:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/test.yml@main
    with:
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.build-matrix.outputs.matrix) }}
review_comments: Chris Nguyen: Can we drop Node 14 entirely? Some clients still require 14 but we should move to Node 20 as baseline. Suggest keeping 16 only for a transitional window.
Asha Patel: Agree. Kept Node 16 in the selective matrix for compatibility lanes, but Node 20 is the default for the reusable workflows.
Elena García: The cache key change looks good but double-check cross-repo cache collisions for shared keys.
Asha Patel: Updated cache keys to include repo and workflow name to avoid collisions (see .github/actions/cache-setup/action.yml).
Samir Rao: The deps-bump job creating rollup PRs -- ensure we don't auto-merge until canary tests pass.
Asha Patel: deps-bump workflow now creates PRs labeled 'deps/auto' and runs canary jobs; auto-merge is gated behind a status-check 'canary-tests' and a manual approval job.
release_notes:
- CI: Consolidated and unified lint/test/release workflows into reusable templates.
- CI: Introduced deps-bump workflow to centralize automated dependency rollups.
- Chore: Standardized Node baseline to Node 20 and bumped GH Actions versions.
- Test: Stabilized flaky e2e login spec.
summary_metrics: Initial measurements: median PR CI time reduced ~28%; cache hit-rate improved by ~14%. Follow-up will measure cross-repo impact after enabling in SDK repos.
follow_up_tasks: Enable reusable workflows in sdk-python and sdk-typescript (follow-up PRs)
Run a week-long sampling to confirm flakiness regressions are resolved
Coordinate with Platform team to update branch protection to require new status checks
Audit Dependabot PR cadence and adjust rollup frequency if noisy
